headline: A data-native language for reliable backend workflows and simulation-driven applications.

status.summary: The public demo is live with commerce and logistics workflows, visible domain-scoped queue health, and hosted smoke checks for reset, transaction, queue, and outbox behavior. The deeper language, tooling, simulation, and production-hardening layers are still maturing.

liveNow: Hosted Railway backend connected to PostgreSQL
Reuben website embed/link for public testing
Compiler checks for schema, query, transaction, migration, seed, and simulation files
Generated TypeScript client, server, and worker scaffolds
Outbox queue processing with retry, dead-letter, stale-claim recovery, domain-scoped queue health, queue stats, and worker observability counters
Hosted smoke checks that validate public reset, transactions, queue health, and outbox processing for both demo domains
Early simulation syntax for PLOS and business-simulation research

milestones.title: Demo Hardening
milestones.goal: Make the public demo feel stable, explainable, and safe for repeat visitors.
items: Improve public demo copy and empty states
Add uptime and post-deploy monitoring
Document public reset/session behavior for testers

milestones.title: Reux Language Depth
milestones.goal: Turn the current useful subset into a stronger application language foundation.
items: Broaden transaction control flow
Deepen expression typing
Improve generated worker contracts
Expand reusable query patterns
Continue tightening compiler diagnostics and safety checks

milestones.title: Simulation Foundation
milestones.goal: Make Reux useful for structured forecasting and scenario comparison.
items: Expand simulation domain packs for PLOS and business operations
Add richer time-series and assumption modeling
Add stronger unit and formula validation
Improve comparison reports and explanation output
Prepare simulation APIs that product apps can call directly

milestones.title: Product Ecosystem
milestones.goal: Keep Reux grounded in real products instead of building language features in isolation.
items: Build PLOS as a personal simulation product using normal web technology first
Build the real-time business simulation engine as an enterprise product prototype
Use Reux underneath both products as the rule, workflow, and simulation layer as it matures
Add more non-commerce pilots to prove the language outside a single domain

milestones.title: Developer Experience
milestones.goal: Make Reux approachable for technical reviewers and early users.
items: Improve editor completions, definitions, and diagnostics
Publish clearer examples and tutorials
Prepare package distribution and installation docs
Add concise getting-started flows for local development and hosted demos

longTermDirection: Decision logic that needs to be auditable and explainable

ecosystem.reuben: The public home for the work.
ecosystem.plos: The personal simulation product that validates individual planning use cases.
ecosystem.businessSimulationEngine: The enterprise product that validates operational and financial decision use cases.
